scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test:clubs: node design/previews/club-live-acceptance.cjs && node design/previews/club-navigation-regression.cjs && node design/previews/mini-club-redesign-regression.cjs && npm run test:club-identity
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:client && npm run test:mini && npm run test:feedback && npm run test:club-identity && npm run test:legal && npm run test:history:client && npm run build
scripts.test:legal: npm run legal:check && node design/previews/legal-live-acceptance.cjs && node design/previews/mini-legal-regression.cjs
scripts.test:history: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --require ./server/test/setup-env.js server/test/race-history.test.js server/test/history-ocr.test.js && npm run test:history:client
scripts.test:content: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --require ./server/test/setup-env.js server/test/content.test.js server/test/news.test.js && node scripts/content-mini-regression.cjs && npm run build && node scripts/content-live-acceptance.cjs
scripts.test:content-sync: node --test scripts/content-sync.test.cjs scripts/content-news-enrichment.test.cjs scripts/athlete-biography.test.cjs scripts/content-date.test.cjs server/test/pacer-people.test.js
